notes.title: Blêktre 2081 is a commercial failure — and that’s excellent news !
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068962/4e5ad470861020f6e24976974142b0cfb1e4a9ba.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Sorry for the slightly clickbait title: first of all, I want to say that [b]development is still very much active[/b], and a [b]major update is on the way[/b]![/p][p]
Blêktre 2081 was first created as a conceptual experiment. Since it was also a video game, publishing it on Steam felt natural. It allowed me to discover what the video game market is really like. After six months of operation, and a rather normal lack of mass appeal, I considered smoothing out Blêktre to make it more compatible with market expectations.[/p][p][/p][p]But after working in that direction, I realized it was stripping away the game’s original idea: offering a [b]radical, sad, and mocking experience[/b] that tells the story of an [b]unjust society[/b]. I still believe this is an interesting and even fun idea — but clearly not for everyone. And if I were to twist Blêktre’s concept to appeal to the widest audience, I think it would end up pleasing no one… starting with me.[/p][p][/p][p]So I decided to drop any commercial ambitions for Blêktre and [b]make the game free via the demo version[/b] (web and Steam). This free version will now have no restrictions, including the save disks that were previously disabled in this mode: you will now be able to resurrect like everyone else.[/p][p][/p][p]Oh, but of course [b]there’s a twist[/b]! To truly simulate real life, you have to know that while all citizens are equal, some are more equal than others… A new major privilege is now granted to the player who reaches the very top of the pyramid — the position of mayor of the city: [b]they will now be able to set the law and decide[/b], among other things, [b]whether refugees playing on a free account can be pursued by player-police officers[/b]. With some skill, those refugees can still evade them and climb the ranks to ultimately [b]change the law in their favor[/b]…[/p][p][/p][p]Freeing Blêktre from commercial ambitions allows me to imagine [b]more radical, more unfair ideas[/b] — but also ones that are more [b]consistent with the nature of the game[/b]. I’m convinced this won’t stop it from being [b]fun and balanced[/b] — quite the opposite. Opposition always finds a way![/p][p][/p][p][b]This update is planned for Fall 2025[/b]. I hope to see you among the testers of this experience, which I now consider more refined than ever. The next version will bring many changes, and I will get back to you with the full details of this true expansion.

In the meantime, I hope real life isn’t that harsh for you — [b]even if you’re prepared with such a high-quality simulator.[/b][/p][p]With love,[/p][p]Charles
[/p]

notes.title: Advertising Boards
notes.content:
A small update before the big one:

* Advertising boards that let you write whatever you want — but more importantly, they can redirect Blêktrians to your business so they consume en masse at your place, not someone else's

* A personal probe is now available at Hackman's to analyze your peers in detail...

This minor update lays the groundwork for a major one currently in development: the startup industrial zone.

In the startup industrial zone, you'll be able to build a business safe from hostile takeovers. The zone may be far from the center, but all you need to do is advertise to attract customers! This update will benefit newcomers, allowing them to grow and thrive without fearing the sharks. Also, alternative ways to obtain Illuminati tokens are gradually appearing.

The world burns better with full pockets!

notes.title: New UI and the ability to defecate on the floor
notes.content:
I invited a UX designer friend over for coffee, and when he saw my game, he spat his drink all over the screen: it was a total mess. He couldn’t instinctively figure out how to play or get through the tutorial. Then he grabbed a stick and started hitting me while explaining what needed to be fixed. Leaving me bloodied and whining on the floor, he told me I’d better rework everything before he came back.

So, I got to work and followed the instructions he had mercifully left me. And I have to say, his feedback was spot-on! I ended up redoing almost everything—from the navigation arrows to the menus, the journal and chat. These features had been haphazardly added throughout development, and they’ve now been reorganized into something much more coherent.

When my UX designer friend came back, I was proud of the result—clearer, more compact, smoother. He was satisfied and said: it’s playable now without making your eyes bleed, congratulations. I narrowly avoided another beating.

For the Steam update, I still wanted to add a little gameplay feature, so I included the ability to defecate on the floor, just in case you can’t afford a toilet. After all, a realistic simulation should consider even the roughest scenarios.

I also told the player Melon Fusk (himself a simulation of a mean human being) to chill out because he was playing too much and it was going to harm his health—not to mention he was getting a bit too nasty with the other players.

A few more bug fixes round things out.

While this update mainly brings quality-of-life improvements, I can already tell you I’m working on content and gameplay refinement updates that I can’t wait to show you and that could significantly impact the overall experience.

In the meantime, ride safe.

Charles Saucisse

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
**Update Notes**

- **New**: Added a chart in the accounting UI for better financial tracking.  
- Toilet prices have been fixed at 10 to prevent mass bot deaths due to lack of basic needs affordability.  
- "Licenses to Live" limits and prices have been reworked to better accommodate a wider range of wealth.  
- Robbers wearing hoods can no longer enter the police station.  
- Robbers' hoods are now automatically removed at the end of the police research cooldown.  
- Fixed a bug where the opponent's name displayed incorrectly during interruptions.  
- Softened several sound effects and added protection against overlapping sounds.  
- Fixed a bug where police research wasn’t properly cleared after sleep.  
- Updated the Steam page images and description, as some visitors mistakenly thought it was a kids' game.  
- Fixed an issue where home toilets appeared as businesses in the trade center.  
- Corrected place names showing incorrectly during character selection.  
- Fixed a bug where hotel rooms occupied by Ray Plicant behaved inappropriately.
- Various additions into the Blektropedia 
- Typos / Translation

Those changes are server-side so you don't need to update the client.

notes.title: The Landing Update ! V1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068962/400507d1da3c81b87b3f8402ab865ba20f14734f.jpg[/img]

[b]Version 1.1 Update![/b]

[h2]The Blêktropedia[/h2]

As highlighted in a positive Steam review, [b]Blêktre 2081 [/b] is unlike any game you've played, making onboarding a challenge.  

But worry no more—the [b]Blêktropedia  [/b] is here! This fully illustrated, lore-packed encyclopedia covers the mechanics and everything you need to master your world… and eat your neighbor!  

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068962/ba174b5ea93a2f749cce6b1ecf160edc5db1e14b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068962/6403492c8f1feceafaf7eb7789dff0b15cfd8630.png[/img][/url]

You can also freely access the Blektropedia from the website and will be updated according to players feedback.

[h2]New Skin[/h2]

This update also introduces a new unlockable character: the [b]Doomer[/b]! They've returned from the Moon and know the terrible truth about the world. Their dedicated non-human version is also included.  

[h2]New Game+[/h2]

After completing the main story and certifying your score, you can earn and accumulate [b]Moons[/b]. Each one can be selected to increase the difficulty when you reroll in New Game+ and further multiply your score!

[h2]Various adjustements and bug fixes[/h2]

- Music volume and SFX sliders 
- A clear visual alert appears when your health drops below 40%  
- Fixed some NPC hats  
- Improved real-time updates for skill effectiveness in combat  
- Carafurs are found all over the world
- The Steam demo no longer requires an account 
- And more ...

[h2]Community[/h2]

[b]Blêktre [/b] is still evolving, and we're always open to your feedback—whether through the in-game form or on Discord.  

More updates and content are on the way!

Love you all!

notes.title: Little Dance Update
notes.content:
[b]Feature[/b]

- People now come to dance when you DJ at the Garden Party.

[b]Tweaks[/b]

- Toilet prices have been capped to prevent a sanitation crisis for those who can't afford them.
- A business's capital fully resets if the owner disappears, making buyouts easier.
- The Capo's sausage production objective now decreases faster for a smoother experience.
- Room Safes are now shared among housemates
- Language Selection for mobile
- Various optimizations.
- The demo is now available for Linux.

notes.title: Safety First update
notes.content:
Released a small update to provide players with more safety information about the dangers of society!  

- An alert now appears if you're vulnerable to police checks (illegal items, criminal status).  
- New perk: Monopolist Scum, when you own several businesses.
- A warning is displayed before taking antidepressants, preventing accidental lifelong addiction.  
- You can no longer slip drugs into NPC pockets—gifts are now limited to gang members.  
- Fanta-Nihil overdose no longer results in death.  
- Corruption: Cops are now immune to police controls.  
- Fixed an animation bug during *The Moon and the Restless* show.  
- Added a safe in your bedroom to store coins securely (limited to your Permit’s maximum).

notes.title: Update Notes for 19/02/2025
notes.content:
The Prestige New Game+ is now live! You can finally reach the Moon for real—but I won’t spoil anything more.

We also started a series of tweaks to help rebalance the game for small entrepreneurs against big business owners, even in such a capitalist world. 

This is however a work in progress and you can join the discussion on [url=https://discord.gg/U7AjZF65KJ]Discord [/url]

notes.title: Release of the game !
notes.content:
After two years of development, [b]Blêktre 2081[/b] is finally fully available on Steam!  

This is my first officially released game, so it's a special moment.  

A huge thank you to all the players who support, test, and buy the game! Have fun!  

Just because the game is out doesn't mean my work is done—I still have features, optimizations, balancing, and events to bring you!  

Feel free to leave a review if you enjoy the game; it can help a lot!  

Love you all!  

[b]Charles[/b]
